text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! We're doing great!
We've won ten whole times!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごいッス！　
やったッスね！
10回も倒したッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
But the enemy still isn't giving up...
Guess we need to keep up our efforts!
text_block_list.orig_text:
けど、
まだ懲りてなさそうッスね……
まだまだ一緒にがんばるッス！
